title: Rihaayi Mil Gayi Rihaayi Mil Gayi
body:
Rihaayi Mil Gayi Rihaayi Mil Gayi
sakina Jaag Utho Jaag Utho
1. Afsos Baad-e-marg Ke Rahath Tumhe Mili
sajjad Ke Pairo'n Ki Bhi Bedi Nikal Gayi
bibi Utho Ab Apni Rida Hum Ko Milgayi
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kanou'n Ka Dard Aur Woh Kurta Jala Huva
rassi Gale Me Bibi Ke Aur Dam Ruka Huva
chote Se Sin Me Bibi Kya Kya Na Seh Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Baba Ke Liye Roti Toh Milti Thi Ghurkiya'n
zaqmi The Kaan Shimr Ne Cheeni Jo Baaliya'n
rahat Tujhe Mil Jayegi Ab Ghar Chalo Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Woh Dekh Kar Parindou'n Ko Ghar Jaane Ka Arma'n
kehti Thi Roke Jayenge Kab Ghar Phupi Amma
chalne Ki Ab Watan Ko Kyun Zid Nahi Karti
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Arma'n Tha Tumko Kitna Ghar Jaane Ka Bibi
zalim Ke Dar Se Tum Na Rato'n Ko Soti Thi
tareek Qaid Qaane Me Neend Aagayi Kaisi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Chal Kar Batana Baba Ko Tum Saari Daasta'n
kaise Huve Masayeb Tum Par Sar-e-zinda'n
ghurbath Me Tum Jo Baap Se Apne Juda Huvi
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sughra Hai Muntazir Ke Kab Aayenge Ghar Hum
sunkar Mere Masayeb Niklega Uska Dum
kya Kehke Mai Samjhau'n Ke Tum Hi Nahi Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Nanhi Si Woh Chadar Teri Asghar Ke Shaluke
kanou'n Ki Baliya'n Teri Aur Jhoole Ke Tukde
yaade'n Mere Bacho'n Ki Daaman Me Hain Bandhi
